clue.text: Following last of interviews, movie star gets something to eat

indicators.note: following means the star's name comes after the letter just picked
the last of a word is its final letter, here taken from interviews

parts.note: Arnie is Arnold Schwarzenegger, the action-film star

explanation.surface: After a round of press interviews, a film star is given a bite to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: SARNIE is British slang for a sandwich.
explanation.definitionFit: A sandwich (British slang term) is a snack, plainly something to eat.

clue.text: Singing voice is out of tune and rising excessively

parts.note: a false note is one sung off pitch

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters are read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: OTT is over the top, i.e. excessive

explanation.surface: A complaint that someone's high singing is flat and climbs too far.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns OTT (over the top) into TTO.
explanation.definitionFit: A falsetto is the artificially high register a male singer uses, a kind of singing voice.

clue.text: Drug and alcohol supplies somewhere in East Africa

indicators.note: the clue words supply, or provide, the run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A report on narcotics and drink being shipped to an East African location.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'drUG AND Alcohol'.
explanation.definitionFit: Uganda is a landlocked country in East Africa, so it is somewhere there.

clue.text: Insect consumes fruit for nourishment

indicators.note: consuming takes the fruit inside the insect's letters, as if swallowed

parts.note: an ant is an insect
a lime is a citrus fruit

explanation.surface: A bug feeds on a piece of fruit to keep itself nourished.
explanation.definitionFit: Aliment is a formal word for food, that which nourishes the body.

clue.text: Put it in oil with a pinch of salt to make appetisers

indicators.note: put together with in tells us to place one piece inside the other
in, after put, places the word it within the oil word

parts.note: crude is unrefined oil

indicators.note: a pinch is a tiny amount, so only the first letter of salt is taken

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: drop it into oil and season lightly to produce starters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with a pinch of salt' adds S at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Crudités are raw vegetable sticks served as starters before a meal.

clue.text: Sportsman about to strike back

indicators.note: back tells us to read the combined pieces in reverse order

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to flog is to strike or beat

explanation.surface: An athlete is on the point of hitting back.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who plays golf is a player of a sport, a sportsman.

clue.text: After short winter month, Annie travels for long periods of time

indicators.note: after places the rearranged name behind the month

parts.note: Dec is the short form of December

indicators.note: travels suggests the letters of the name moving about into new places

explanation.surface: Once early December arrives, Annie goes off on lengthy trips.
explanation.definitionFit: Decennia is the plural of decennium, a span of ten years, a decade.

clue.text: Two young females hold an aromatic plant

indicators.note: the pair of girl words hold the small word between them
two says the girls' word is written twice

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A pair of girls are holding a fragrant herb.
explanation.definitionFit: Galangal is a ginger-like rhizome used as a fragrant flavouring in Asian cooking.

clue.text: Building worker replacing fire door I'd taken out

indicators.note: replacing suggests rearranging, putting the letters back in different places
taken out says the letters of I'd are removed from the pool

explanation.surface: A tradesman is swapping out a fire door that someone had removed.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove I and D from FIRE DOOR and rearrange what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofer builds and repairs roofs, a worker in the building trade.

clue.text: Peacekeeping organisation is against making agreement

parts.note: the UN, United Nations, sends peacekeeping forces
on means against, as in leaning on a wall

explanation.surface: The UN declares itself opposed to reaching a settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in unison means acting in harmony or concord, all together.

clue.text: One who changes single note during reworking of Do-Re-Mi

indicators.note: during puts the two short pieces inside the rearranged song letters
reworking means the letters of the song are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single
F is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone tweaks one note while rearranging the Sound of Music tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reworking of' turns DOREMI into MODIER; I and F go inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A modifier is anything or anyone that alters something, as in grammar a word altering another.

clue.text: Chill out, then shower? Check!

parts.note: to chill out is to relax or rest
a shower is a short fall of rain

explanation.surface: A to-do list: relax, then wash, then tick it off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shower' is weather, not washing; 'Check!' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To check something is to hold it back, curb or restrain it.

clue.text: Reading, for example, and working when in the toilet

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the word the

parts.note: reading is one of the three Rs of schooling, so it gives R
on means working, functioning

explanation.surface: Reading while busy on the loo, a familiar pastime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reading' is the three Rs (reading, writing, arithmetic), not the English town. 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Throne is jocular slang for a lavatory seat, so it stands for the toilet.

clue.text: Cheek getting squeezed by the bottom part of extremely small underwear

indicators.note: being squeezed by means the cheek word sits tightly between the other letters
the bottom part of a word is its last letter

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
front means cheek, effrontery

explanation.surface: A buttock pinched by very skimpy briefs.
explanation.walkthrough: Y, the end of 'extremely', and S go round FRONT.
explanation.definitionFit: Y-fronts are men's briefs with an inverted Y seam at the front, a kind of underpants.

clue.text: Fleetwood's first hit with one new golf ball is a flyer

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of Fleetwood's

parts.note: to lam is to hit hard
I is the Roman numeral one
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet
O looks like a ball

explanation.surface: A golfer from Fleetwood strikes a new ball first, sending it soaring.
explanation.definitionFit: The flamingo is a pink wading bird, and birds are flyers.

clue.text: Playing nose flutes without the tips of one's fingers can be unmelodic

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are put to work in a new order
without says those letters are removed before rearranging
tips are the first letters of each of the words named

explanation.surface: Playing a nose flute without using your fingertips sounds awful.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove O and F, the tips of 'one's fingers', from NOSE FLUTES and rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuneless music lacks melody, which is what unmelodic means.

clue.text: Red sauce mostly transported in a crate?

indicators.note: transported suggests the letters are carried off into a new order
mostly means the word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Ketchup being shipped in a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts SAUCE to SAUC; 'transported' rearranges it with RED. 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Crate is slang for an old, battered car, typically a second-hand one.

clue.text: Crucial events could be described without book

indicators.note: could be suggests the letters might become another word when rearranged
without tells us to drop the book letter from the pool

explanation.surface: Key moments could be recounted without a text.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove B from DESCRIBED and rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Deciders are games or moments that settle a contest, so crucial events.

clue.text: Put money in side pot to be dished out

indicators.note: dished out suggests the letters are scattered or handed round in a new order

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes on a side pot that will be shared out.
explanation.definitionFit: To deposit is to place money in a bank or account.

clue.text: Crazy Australian tucking into ecstasy before noon

definitions.note: used as a noun: a crazy is informal for a lunatic

indicators.note: before puts the drug piece ahead of the noon letter
tucking into puts one letter inside the drug's letters

parts.note: MDMA is the chemical name for the drug ecstasy
N for noon, as in the noon-day abbreviation

explanation.surface: A wild Australian is taking ecstasy before midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crazy' must be read as a noun ('a crazy').
explanation.definitionFit: A crazy, as a noun, is a lunatic, someone out of their mind.

clue.text: Plant providing more nuts

definitions.meaning: a plant whose root gives a red dye
nuts means crazy, so more nuts is crazier

explanation.surface: A plant that gives you something nuttier.
explanation.definitionFit: Madder is a red-dye plant; it is also the comparative of mad, which means crazier.

clue.text: Training cut without hesitation

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so cut goes round hesitation

parts.note: to excise is to cut out
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A coach slashes a training session without pausing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' reads as 'lacking', but here it has its old sense of 'outside'.
explanation.definitionFit: Exercise is physical training, or a drill done to practise.

clue.text: Decadent European female at social function

parts.note: a fete is a social gathering or fair

explanation.surface: A self-indulgent European woman at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Effete describes a person weakened by over-refinement and self-indulgence, i.e. decadent.

clue.text: Hi-fi store gets revamped (including online)

indicators.note: including takes the online letter into the rearranged word
revamped means remade, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: E, as in e-commerce, stands for online or electronic

explanation.surface: A sound-system shop gets a refit, adding an internet presence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets revamped' turns STORE into STREO, which takes E inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A stereo is a sound system, and hi-fi is another name for one.

clue.text: Wine accompanies a bit of dahl, potato and hot curry

parts.note: vin is French for wine

indicators.note: a bit of means just the first letter of dahl

parts.note: aloo is the Hindi word for potato, used on Indian menus

explanation.surface: A curry-house order: wine with some dahl, potatoes and a fiery curry.
explanation.definitionFit: Vindaloo is a very spicy Indian dish of Goan origin.

clue.text: Fellow has more rum and grub

parts.note: rum means odd, so more rum is odder

explanation.surface: A man drinks extra rum along with some food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' is the adjective meaning strange, not the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Fodder is food, especially for animals, and grub is slang for food.

clue.text: Don't start to go back, go out!

indicators.note: don't start says the first letter of the word is left off

parts.note: to regress is to go back

explanation.surface: An exasperated order: don't begin retreating, just leave!
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, egress means to exit, to leave a place.

clue.text: Prior to the start of denials, the Web detailed what Lewinsky did in the White House

definitions.text: what Lewinsky did in the White House

indicators.note: prior to puts the Web piece ahead of the next letter
detailed means the tail, the last letter, is cut off

parts.note: the Web is the internet

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Before the denials began, the internet revealed in detail the Clinton intern affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like 'in detail' but means 'tail removed'. Monica Lewinsky was a White House intern.
explanation.definitionFit: To intern is to work as a trainee; Lewinsky served as an intern at the White House.
